class.name: TrainsetData
class.description: Its vehicles stand on the track one after another from the offset and are coupled ([code]RailVehicleServer.trainset_place()[/code]); a vehicle outside any trainset is a trainset of one, standing by its own track and offset.

method.name: get_arranged_members
method.description: Its members as [param arranged] lists them (a scenery's trainset_override) when every declared member there stands at its place in this trainset, its declared ones otherwise. An entry is paired with its declared member by its place ([member TrainsetMemberData.trainset_index]); a declared member becomes the entry's vehicle, turned its way, its crew, load and gap kept; an added one is a copy of the vehicle before it with nobody aboard, no load, no gap, an id of its own and no name. Each couples to the next by the entry's [member TrainsetMemberData.coupling_mode] - the one the arrangement shows and the player chose.

method.name: get_driver_vehicle
method.description: The vehicle the player starts in: the one with a driver in its front cab, else in its rear one, else the first; null for a trainset without vehicles.

method.name: is_occupied
method.description: A driver sits in one of its vehicles, so the player can take the trainset - the original's launcher refuses one without.

members.member: What the scenario says the train is to do.
Its vehicles and how they stand, front first.
Its name - the resource's own ([member Resource.resource_name]); empty for a vehicle outside a trainset.
The distance along the track its front stands at [m].
The scenario offers the trainset to the player.
The timetable of its driver - its first order; empty for a vehicle outside a trainset.
The track its front stands on.
The velocity it starts with [km/h], along the track - its driver's first order; a reversed vehicle starts with it negated.
